items.abstract: <jats:p>Various questions arise once the SLC/SEE results are published every year. The major question has been though, "are the students being evaluated correctly?". Many say, these exams just evaluate the memorizing capability of students. One of the major purposes of assessment is to communicate achievement level of the student to different stakeholders. This communication would be more effective when reporting was more comprehensive. Currently, schools focus on evaluating the academic performance of students. But the evaluations are incidental. There is a need to assess the learning of students continuously and holistically. Schools are envisioned to be a place of complete learning. Only academic assessment shouldn't be the means to determine a child's learnings. Thus, holistic education system has to be implemented in order to produce competent future generations with balanced cognitive, affective and psychomotor domains which can lead the nation towards prosperity.    <br><br>The paper tries to exhibit why the traditional evaluation system has to be dropped, the adoption of Letter Grading System, and the future prospects towards evaluation systems that can be adopted at schools</jats:p>
title: Towards Holistic Education Through Continuous and Comprehensive Evaluation
